title: Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel — Specification (Seventh Revision)
scope: This standard specifies requirements for hot rolled medium and high tensile structural steel intended for use in structural work, bridges, towers and buildings.
qco_reference: Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order, 2024 (S.O. 1827(E))

clauses.title: Chemical Composition
clauses.content: Carbon equivalent (CE) based on ladle analysis shall not exceed 0.42 for Grade E250 quality A, B and C structural steel.

clauses.title: Tensile Properties
clauses.content: Tensile strength for Grade E250 shall be 410 MPa minimum, with yield strength not less than 250 MPa for thickness less than 20 mm.

clauses.title: Charpy V-Notch Impact Test
clauses.content: Impact energy for Quality BR/B0 shall not be less than 27 Joules at specified test temperatures (0 deg C or -20 deg C).
